 At Jabalpur

sentences.text:
Order 
This is the first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

2. The applicant has been arrested on 08.06.2024 by Police Station Begumganj, District Raisen (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.172 of 2024 for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366 and 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 5(L)/6 of the POCSO Act.
3. This application has been filed on the ground that there is no allegation of committing rape against the present applicant.
Only allegation against the present applicant is that on telephone he has informed the victim regarding the route to Gujrat, whereby the victim met with the principal accused.
Subsequently, in a statement which was recorded at the one stop centre, she alleged that the present applicant confined her for two days and her mobile was also snatched.
However, in the earlier statements which were recorded under Section 161 and 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, there was no allegation against the present applicant.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and 2 MCRC-27203-2024 conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering his bail application.
As there is no further requirement of the custodial interrogation of the applicant, he prays for grant of bail.
4. Per contra, learned counsel appearing for the State has vehemently opposed the contentions pointing out the fact that in one stop centre, she has given a statement involving the present applicant.
She has categorically stated that she was confined by the present applicant for two days and her mobile was also snatched.
However, he could not dispute the fact that in the earlier statements, the victim did not state anything against the present applicant.
The applicant being the first offender as per the case diary record, is also not disputed by the state counsel.

sentences.text: Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court deems it appropriate to allow this application.
Accordingly, the application is allowed subject to verification of the fact that the applicant is a first offender.

He is directed to be released on bail on furnishing surety bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand)
with one local surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the conditions as enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
6.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
7. The application is accordingly allowed.
(VISHAL MISHRA) JUDGE 3 MCRC-27203-2024 sj Neelesh Jatav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187395525/
